title: Redbrand Hideout · Area 9 · Bugbear barracks

sourceRecords.title: 15 · Bugbears and Droop · area 9
read: Three large figures occupy the room as though it belongs to them. A goblin nearby flinches at your arrival and looks ready to disappear into the floor.

The room's sleeping places and the positions of those inside shape the space available for an approach. You have a moment to note who watches you, who avoids your gaze, and where the door sits behind you. Words are still an option before the first movement becomes an attack.

brief: Rough barracks: FOUR crudely made wooden bunks, heaped blankets, dirty dishes and scraps of meat. THREE tall furry bugbears with broad ears lounge among the mess. Leader Mosk has a black leather jeweled eye patch. ONE little goblin Droop crouches low in distress, beginning to faint at the doorway. Practical oil lamps, stone room. No player characters, no death, no fourth bugbear, no declaration of allegiance.
